papers.title: Augmented Human Capital: A Unified Theory and LLM-Based Measurement Framework for Cognitive Factor Decomposition in AI-Augmented Economies
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a decomposition of human capital into three orthogonal components -- physical-manual (H^P), routine-cognitive (H^C), and augmentable-cognitive (H^A) -- and develops a production function in which AI capital interacts asymmetrically with these components: substituting for routine cognitive work while complementing augmentable cognitive work through an amplification function phi(D). I derive a corrected Mincerian wage equation and show that the standard specification is misspecified in AI-augmented economies. Using LLM-generated measures of occupational augmentability for 18,796 O*NET task statements mapped to 440 Colombian occupations, merged with household survey microdata (N = 105,517 workers), I estimate the augmented Mincer equation. The wage return to H^A increases with AI adoption in the formal sector (beta_2 = +0.051, p < 0.001), while informal workers cannot capture augmentation rents (beta_2 = -0.044). A triple interaction confirms formality as the binding mechanism (beta_{AHC x D x Formal} = +0.272, p < 0.001). The augmentation premium is strongest for experienced workers (ages 46-65) and in health and education sectors. These results provide the first developing-country evidence of cognitive factor decomposition in AI-augmented labor markets and demonstrate that the binding constraint on human-AI complementarity in the Global South is not technology access but labor market institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本文提出将人力资本分解为三个正交组成部分：体力-手工型（H^P）、常规-认知型（H^C）和可增强型-认知型（H^A），并构建了一个生产函数，在该函数中人工智能（AI）资本与这些组成部分之间的互动具有非对称性：AI资本可以替代常规认知型劳动，同时通过一个放大函数phi(D)对可增强型认知型劳动起到互补作用。我推导出了一个修正后的明瑟工资方程，并指出在人工智能驱动的经济体中，标准的劳动力市场模型存在设定错误。利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成的18,796项O*NET任务描述（对应440个哥伦比亚职业）的可增强性指标，并结合家庭调查微观数据（N = 105,517名工人），我对修正后的明瑟工资方程进行了估计。研究发现，在正规部门中，随着AI技术的采用，H^A类型的劳动力获得的工资回报显著增加（beta_2 = +0.051，p < 0.001）；而非正规部门劳动者则无法获得这种工资溢价（beta_2 = -0.044）。三重交互作用进一步证实了正规就业形式是决定这种工资差异的关键因素（beta_{AHC x D x Formal} = +0.272，p < 0.001）。此外，这种工资溢...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: From Pluralistic Ignorance to Common Knowledge with Social Assurance Contracts
papers.abstract: Societies and organizations often fail to surface latent consensus because individuals fear social censure. A manager might suspect a silent majority would offer a criticism, support a change, report a risk, or endorse a policy -- if only it were safe. Likewise, individuals with beliefs they think are rare and controversial might stay quiet for fear of consequences at work or an online mob. In both cases pluralistic ignorance produces a public discourse misaligned with privately-held beliefs. Social assurance contracts unlock latent consensus, making the public discussion more accurately reflect the underlying distribution of actual beliefs. They are akin to an open letter that publishes only when a stated threshold number of private signatures is reached. If it is not reached, nothing is revealed and no one is exposed. Whereas a single hand raised in dissent might get cut off, a thousand can be raised safely together. I build a formal model and derive rules for choosing the threshold. The mechanism (i) induces participation from those willing to speak if assured of company, resolving the core coordination problem in pluralistic ignorance; (ii) makes the threshold a transparent policy lever -- sponsors can maximize success, maximize public-coalition revelation, or hit a desired success probability; and (iii) turns success into information: meeting the threshold publicly reveals hidden agreement and can widen the range of views that can be expressed in public. I consider robustness to mistrust, organized opposition, and network structure, and outline low-trust implementations like cryptographic escrow. Applications include employee voice, safety and compliance, whistleblowing, and civic expression.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】社会和组织常常无法将潜在的共识显现出来，因为个人害怕受到社会的谴责。管理者可能会认为，如果环境足够安全的话，沉默的大多数人其实会提出批评意见、支持变革、报告风险或赞同某项政策。同样，那些持有自己认为罕见且具有争议性观点的人，也可能因为担心工作场所的负面后果或网络上的舆论压力而选择保持沉默。在这两种情况下，多元无知（即人们因害怕负面后果而不表达真实想法）会导致公共讨论与个人真实信念之间存在偏差。社会保障契约（social assurance contracts）能够打破这种沉默，使公共讨论更准确地反映人们的真实信念分布。这类契约类似于一种“公开信”：只有当达到预先设定的私人签名数量门槛时才会被公开；如果未达到这一门槛，任何信息都不会被泄露，也不会有人因此受到指责。与单独一个人表达反对意见可能招致麻烦不同，成千上万的人可以安全地共同发声。我建立了一个正式模型，并制定了选择合适门槛的规则。这种机制：（1）能够激励那些在有保障的情况下愿意发言的人参与讨论，从而解决多元无知环境中的核心协调问题；（2）使门槛成为一种透明的政策工具——发起者可以最大化成功的可能性、最大化公众与联盟之间的信息共...。

papers.title: Active versus passive investment strategy and market outperformance: are hedge funds overrated?
papers.abstract:
This paper aims to contribute to the active-versus-passive investment debate by examining whether hedge funds generate market outperformance and, more broadly, whether they create value beyond persistent alpha. While hedge funds are often perceived as vehicles for superior returns, their continued growth despite high fees raises the question of what explains their attractiveness if consistent outperformance is absent. The study therefore evaluates both alpha generation and alternative sources of portfolio value, including diversification benefits and downside-risk mitigation.
 
 
 
 The analysis is based on a comprehensive sample of 3,828 hedge funds with monthly observations from February 2014 to January 2024. Market-adjusted performance is estimated using established asset-pricing frameworks, including Jensen’s alpha model, the Fama–French multi-factor model and the Fung–Hsieh hedge fund factor model. Beyond average alpha estimates, the study examines the cross-sectional distribution of excess returns, market beta exposure and implications for portfolio efficiency and risk-adjusted performance.
 
 
 
 The results show no consistent evidence of market outperformance: average alpha estimates are statistically indistinguishable from zero across the sample. However, important distributional patterns emerge. Over the 10-year horizon, more hedge funds achieved positive than negative excess returns. Moreover, hedge funds exhibit relatively low and often asymmetric market betas, indicating that their value lies less in persistent alpha generation and more in enhancing portfolio efficiency through diversification and downside-risk mitigation. These benefits are particularly relevant during periods of market stress.
 
 
 
 Hedge fund data sets often exclude funds that closed or stopped reporting, which may lead to upward-biased performance estimates. The authors explain in the paper how they approach this potential survivorship bias.
 
 
 
 Investors and asset managers should recalibrate expectations: hedge funds should not be viewed primarily as vehicles for beating the market, but as effective instruments for improving risk-adjusted performance and providing resilience in diversified portfolios. This is especially valid during market stress.
 
 
 
 This paper extends the active-versus-passive debate by shifting the focus from alpha generation to the broader risk–return profile of hedge funds. While prior literature predominantly evaluates hedge funds on their ability to beat the market, this study highlights their context-dependent role as instruments for improving risk-adjusted performance and portfolio resilience. By emphasizing distributional patterns and beta characteristics rather than average alpha alone, the paper offers a refined perspective on the economic function of hedge funds in contemporary investment strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本文旨在通过探讨对冲基金是否能够实现市场超额收益，以及它们是否能够在持续获得阿尔法收益（alpha）的基础上创造更多价值，从而为“主动投资与被动投资”的争论提供新的视角。尽管对冲基金常被视为能够带来较高回报的工具，但鉴于其高昂的管理费用却仍能持续发展，这就引发了这样一个问题：如果缺乏持续的市场超额收益，是什么使得对冲基金具有吸引力呢？因此，本研究不仅评估了对冲基金的阿尔法收益生成能力，还考察了其他可能增加投资组合价值的因素，包括多元化带来的好处以及降低下行风险的能力。

分析基于一个包含3,828只对冲基金的综合样本，数据覆盖了2014年2月至2024年1月的每月观测数据。市场调整后的收益是通过一系列成熟的资产定价模型进行估算的，这些模型包括詹森阿尔法模型（Jensen’s alpha model）、法玛-弗兰奇多因子模型（Fama–French multi-factor model）以及冯-谢对冲基金因子模型（Fung–Hsieh hedge fund factor model）。除了对阿尔法收益的估算外，研究还分析了超额收益的分布特征、市场贝塔系数（market beta e...。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Preferences for Warning Signal Quality: Experimental Evidence -- by Alexander Ugarov, Arya Gaduh, Peter McGee
papers.abstract: We use a laboratory experiment to study preferences over false-positive and false-negative rates of warning signals for an adverse event with a known prior. We find that subjects decrease their demand with signal quality, but less than predicted by our theory. There is asymmetric under-responsiveness by prior: for a low (high) prior, their willingness-to-pay does not fully adjust for the increase in the false-positive (false-negative) costs. We show that neither risk preference nor Bayesian updating skills can fully explain our results. Our results are most consistent with a decision-making heuristic in which subjects do not distinguish between false-positive and false-negative errors.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们通过实验室实验研究了在已知先验信息的情况下，人们对预警信号中误报（false-positive）和漏报（false-negative）率的偏好。研究发现，随着信号质量的提高，受试者的需求会降低，但降低的程度低于理论预测的结果。此外，先验信息对受试者反应的影响存在不对称性：当先验概率较低（或较高）时，他们的支付意愿并未充分反映误报/漏报成本增加所带来的影响。实验结果表明，无论是风险偏好还是贝叶斯更新能力都无法完全解释这一现象。我们的研究结果最符合一种决策启发式机制——即受试者无法区分误报和漏报这两种错误类型。。研究方法：实验方法、贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Bank Fees and Household Financial Well-Being -- by Michaela Pagel, Sharada Sridhar, Emily Williams
papers.abstract: In this study, we examine policy changes from large U.S. banks between 2017 and 2022, which eliminated non-sufficient funds (NSF) fees and relaxed overdraft policies. Using individual transaction-level data, we find that the elimination of NSF fees, not surprisingly, resulted in immediate reductions in NSF charges across the income distribution. However, relaxing overdraft policies resulted in reductions in overdraft fees only for wealthier households, along the dimensions of income and liquidity, and only those enjoyed subsequent declines in late fees, interest payments, account maintenance fees, and the use of alternative financial services, such as payday loans. Our results thus suggest that the policy changes were not substantial enough to significantly reduce the financial stress of the more vulnerable households. As our setting features multiple treatments and variation in treatment intensities, we theoretically motivate and empirically implement a new stacked event study estimator closely related to de Chaisemartin et al (2024) to address the biases arising from staggered DID specifications.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究考察了2017年至2022年间美国大型银行的政策变化，这些变化取消了“非充足资金”（NSF）费用并放宽了透支政策。通过分析个体交易层面的数据，我们发现取消NSF费用后，不同收入阶层的NSF费用确实立即出现了下降。然而，放宽透支政策仅对较富裕的家庭产生了积极影响，具体体现在收入和流动性方面；这些家庭还享受到了滞纳金、利息支付、账户维护费用的减少，以及更少使用 payday loans（发薪日贷款）等替代金融服务的好处。因此，我们的研究结果表明，这些政策变化并不足以显著减轻弱势家庭的财务压力。由于研究环境涉及多种政策干预措施及其实施强度的差异，我们从理论上提出了一个新的分层事件研究估计方法（该方法与de Chaisemartin等人（2024年）的研究方法密切相关），并通过实证分析验证了其有效性，以解决因DID（差分-in-differences）模型设计可能导致的偏差问题。。研究方法：事件研究。

papers.title: The Cointegrated Matrix Autoregressive Model
papers.abstract: Traditional econometric analyzes represent observations as vectors despite the inherent complexity of empirical data structures. When data are organized along dual classification dimensions, a matrix representation provides a more natural and interpretable framework. Building on recent advances in matrix autoregressive (MAR) modeling, this study introduces a novel error correction representation tailored for matrix-structured data. Through comparative analysis with existing methodologies, we demonstrate two critical advancements. First, the proposed model preserves the interpretative foundations of conventional cointegration analysis, with coefficients that explicitly capture dynamics rooted in adjustment toward steady-state positions. Second, in contrast to previous formulations, our error correction framework allows for an equivalent matrix autoregressive representation, preserving the fundamental structure of the data in both specifications. This ensures that the matrix representation reflects an intrinsic characteristic of the data.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】传统的计量经济分析将观测值表示为向量，尽管实证数据结构本身具有复杂性。当数据沿着双重分类维度进行组织时，矩阵表示方式能够提供一个更为自然且易于解释的框架。基于矩阵自回归（MAR）建模的最新进展，本研究提出了一种专为矩阵结构数据设计的新误差修正表示方法。通过与现有方法的比较分析，我们展示了两个关键的创新点：首先，所提出的模型保留了传统协整分析的解释基础，其系数能够明确捕捉到数据向稳态位置调整的过程；其次，与以往的建模方法不同，我们的误差修正框架允许使用等价的矩阵自回归表示形式，从而在两种模型设定中均保留了数据的基本结构。这确保了矩阵表示方式能够真实反映数据的内在特征。。研究方法：协整分析。

papers.title: An analytical model of Disequilibrium and decentralized productive Exploration
papers.abstract: This paper studies the economic role of persistent dispersion in allocations across agents. We develop a tractable model in which firms allocate resources under imperfect information and behavioral updating, generating sustained heterogeneity in beliefs and actions. While dispersion induces static misallocation, it also fosters decentralized experimentation, allowing the economy to explore a broader set of productive opportunities. We show that the economy converges to a stationary equilibrium with strictly positive dispersion and that, under plausible conditions, such disequilibrium can dominate the perfectly coordinated benchmark. The model provides a novel interpretation of observed dispersion in productivity and returns as reflecting both inefficiency and productive exploration. It also yields testable predictions linking dispersion to growth and innovation dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了持久性分散在代理人之间资源分配中的经济作用。我们构建了一个易于处理的模型，在该模型中，企业在信息不完全和行为更新的情况下进行资源分配，从而导致信念和行为的持续异质性。虽然分散会引发静态的资源配置失衡，但它也促进了分散化的实验活动，使经济能够探索更多具有生产力的机会。我们发现，当分散程度严格为正时，经济会收敛到一个稳态均衡；在某些合理的条件下，这种非均衡状态可能会超越完全协调的基准状态。该模型为观察到的生产力和回报分散现象提供了一种新的解释，认为这种分散既反映了效率低下，也体现了生产力的探索过程。此外，该模型还提出了可检验的预测，将分散性与经济增长和创新动态联系起来。。研究方法：实验方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Screening Workers with Affirmative Action
papers.abstract: This paper examines the optimal contracts in a two-dimensional screening model where one dimension(group identity) is verifiable by agents but not falsifiable. A principal offers contracts to agents who differ in cost types and group membership. Motivated by the United States Federal policy, Work Opportunity Tax Credit, the principal receives tax benefits for hiring agents from protected groups. Under the assumption that the protected agents tend to have higher cost types, the optimal contract induces full separation across both dimensions: agents reveal the cost type and the group identity through contract choice. Furthermore, the principal is willing to hire the trait agents with a higher cost threshold than the non-trait agents, and this threshold increases with the tax credit. Conversely, when the protected agents tend to have lower cost types, the optimal design without tax credits pools groups while separating by cost type. These results demonstrate that both affirmative action and non-discrimination can be optimal depending on the cost distribution ordering across groups.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】本文研究了一个二维筛选模型中的最优契约设计。在该模型中，其中一个维度（群体身份）能够被代理人验证，但无法被伪造。委托人向具有不同成本类型和群体归属的代理人提供契约。研究灵感来源于美国的“工作机会税收抵免”政策：雇主雇佣受保护群体中的代理人可享受税收优惠。在假设受保护群体中的代理人通常具有较高成本类型的条件下，最优契约设计实现了两个维度上的完全分离——代理人通过选择契约来披露自己的成本类型和群体身份。此外，委托人更愿意雇佣具有较高成本门槛的代理人（即具有特定特征的代理人），且这一门槛会随着税收抵免政策的实施而提高。相反，当受保护群体中的代理人通常具有较低成本类型时，最优契约设计会在保持群体划分的同时按成本类型进行分类。这些结果表明，根据群体间的成本分布情况，无论是平权措施还是非歧视政策都可能成为最优选择。。

papers.title: Green Subsidies and Local Transitions: Evidence from Energy Communities
papers.abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness and incidence of the renewable energy Production Tax Credit (PTC) and Investment Tax Credit (ITC). I leverage new geographical variation in the 2023 PTC and ITC to test whether renewable energy credits had real economic impacts. Communities with greater tax credits accumulated 32% more renewable energy capital and produced 28% more renewable energy compared to similar counties. These renewable investments had local economic spillovers, increasing county level construction wages by 7%. However, local increases in investment and wages from renewable projects did not improve political support for renewable energy, but rather increased opposition to congressional action on climate change by 2%.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文研究了可再生能源生产税收抵免（PTC）和投资税收抵免（ITC）的政策效果及其实施范围。通过分析2023年PTC和ITC在不同地区的差异，本文验证了这些税收抵免措施是否对可再生能源产业产生了实际的经济影响。与同类地区相比，获得更多税收抵免的社区在可再生能源投资方面积累了32%更多的资本，并生产了28%更多的可再生能源。这些可再生能源投资带来了显著的本地经济效应，使县级建筑行业的工资水平提高了7%。然而，可再生能源项目带来的本地投资和工资增长并未提升公众对可再生能源政策的支持度，反而使得人们对国会应对气候变化的行动的反对情绪增加了2%。。

papers.title: HabitatAgent: An End-to-End Multi-Agent System for Housing Consultation
papers.abstract: Housing selection is a high-stakes and largely irreversible decision problem. We study housing consultation as a decision-support interface for housing selection. Existing housing platforms and many LLM-based assistants often reduce this process to ranking or recommendation, resulting in opaque reasoning, brittle multi-constraint handling, and limited guarantees on factuality.   We present HabitatAgent, the first LLM-powered multi-agent architecture for end-to-end housing consultation. HabitatAgent comprises four specialized agent roles: Memory, Retrieval, Generation, and Validation. The Memory Agent maintains multi-layer user memory through internal stages for constraint extraction, memory fusion, and verification-gated updates; the Retrieval Agent performs hybrid vector--graph retrieval (GraphRAG); the Generation Agent produces evidence-referenced recommendations and explanations; and the Validation Agent applies multi-tier verification and targeted remediation. Together, these agents provide an auditable and reliable workflow for end-to-end housing consultation.   We evaluate HabitatAgent on 100 real user consultation scenarios (300 multi-turn question--answer pairs) under an end-to-end correctness protocol. A strong single-stage baseline (Dense+Rerank) achieves 75% accuracy, while HabitatAgent reaches 95%.
papers.summary_zh: 【房地产金融】住房选择是一个风险极高且几乎不可逆的决策问题。我们研究了住房咨询作为住房选择过程中的决策支持工具。现有的住房平台和许多基于大型语言模型（LLM）的辅助工具通常将这一过程简化为排序或推荐，导致推理过程不透明、多约束处理能力较弱，以及对事实准确性的保障有限。我们提出了HabitatAgent，这是首个基于LLM的多智能体架构，用于实现端到端的住房咨询服务。HabitatAgent包含四个专门的智能体角色：记忆智能体（Memory）、检索智能体（Retrieval）、生成智能体（Generation）和验证智能体（Validation）。记忆智能体通过内部机制维护多层次的用户信息，包括约束提取、信息融合以及基于验证结果的更新；检索智能体采用混合向量-图检索（GraphRAG）技术；生成智能体提供基于证据的推荐和解释；验证智能体则执行多层次的验证和针对性的问题修正。这些智能体共同构成了一个可审计、可靠的端到端住房咨询工作流程。我们在100个真实用户咨询场景（共300个多轮问答对）中评估了HabitatAgent的性能，依据端到端正确性评估标准，传统的单阶段基线方法（Dense+Reran...。
